title: Objetivos: a goals tab, money first

screens.title: 1 · Objetivos, empty
screens.why: A fourth tab, the goals out of Entregas, saying what a goal is.

pins.label: Tab
pins.text: Objetivos between Entregas and Menu, the target icon (AppIcons.goal, Phosphor) the goals already had.

pins.label: First goal
pins.text: One line on what a goal is and a + Novo objetivo; the FAB does the same on this tab.

pins.label: FAB
pins.text: The + writes a goal on Objetivos, as it writes a delivery on Entregas.

screens.title: 2 · Novo objetivo
screens.why: Two choices: how much, and by when. The day is offered, not asked.

pins.label: Amount
pins.text: Money only, whole reais, big and focused on open. No kind, no period.

pins.label: By when
pins.text: Próxima semana (its Sunday) · Próximo mês (its last day, picked on open) · Outra data (the wheel).

pins.label: The day
pins.text: The chosen day, always shown; a tap opens the wheel to change it by hand.

pins.label: Readback
pins.text: Read back with where it starts (today, or the day after the last goal) and the pace per week.

screens.title: 3 · A goal under way
screens.why: The two bars of a delivery, for money: billed against what the days ask by now.

pins.label: Dual bar
pins.text: Green: money delivered since it began / target. Red: what its days ask by today, target × time gone.

pins.label: Key
pins.text: R$ billed in green, R$ asked by today in red (danger ink when behind).

pins.label: Pace tag
pins.text: Abaixo do ritmo by R$ when the red leads by more than 15 % of the target, else No ritmo / acima.

pins.label: Queue
pins.text: What open deliveries due by its day are worth: what could still count.

pins.label: Próximos
pins.text: A goal written while one runs starts the day after it: quiet, no bar.

pins.label: Anteriores
pins.text: Past goals, newest first: Alcançado, or what was reached. Long press removes.

screens.title: 4 · Money on a delivery
screens.why: Every delivery can carry a value, which is what a money goal counts.

pins.label: Valor
pins.text: Always editable now; a kind's price only fills it in (do tipo …).

pins.label: Conta para
pins.text: Names the goal its value will count towards once delivered.

screens.title: 5 · The delivery's page
screens.why: Its value on a line of its own, editable later.

pins.label: Valor
pins.text: Its own row under Tipo; a tap edits it (PATCH { value }); none reads Adicionar valor.
